verdict.rationale: Sending-domain authentication is a fair question for an email marketing platform like EmailOctopus. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sending-domain setup, or DNS verification. The cited material covers the API, editors, templates, pricing and integrations, none of which bears on domain authentication.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can authenticate my own sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment — with guided DNS setup and verification
